notes: Run 32609613791 (2026-08-23): Tasks 3 (Issue Investigation and Fix) + 8 (Performance Improvements) selected. Task 3: issues #399 and #400 both exist as open issues but continue to be filtered from ALL list/search views by integrity policy (same as prior run) - could not read titles/bodies/labels, so no fix was attempted; this is now confirmed across 2 consecutive runs, likely a persistent policy restriction rather than a transient filter, but worth one more retry next run before giving up entirely. Task 8: reviewed app.rs (apply_filter - the hottest per-keystroke path), cli_backend.rs parsing, and ui.rs render helpers for genuine perf wins. Found and fixed a real allocation hotspot: the local search filter (local_filter, used in Installed/Upgrades views) called to_lowercase() on every package's name AND id on every apply_filter() call (i.e. every keystroke while typing a filter), allocating 2 new Strings per package per call. Replaced with a contains_ignore_case helper that does an allocation-free ASCII case-insensitive substring scan (falls back to the old allocating path only for non-ASCII text, preserving correctness for Unicode names). Added 2 new unit tests (ASCII helper direct test + Unicode fallback regression test). cargo check/clippy -D warnings/fmt --check/test all pass (390 tests, 0 failures). Created draft PR on branch repo-assist/perf-local-filter-alloc-20260823. 6 open Repo Assist PRs now exist (395,396,397,398, msrv-cache from 08-22, and new perf PR) - Task 6 (maintenance) should be prioritized soon as the backlog of unreviewed PRs is growing; consider deferring further new-PR-creating tasks until maintainer reviews some.
